EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hide-and-seek?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}That was ages ago!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
We{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} were hiding for forever, but you
never came to find us!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}We were waiting so long, we finally
had to stop hiding and get some
snacks.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Jugar al escondite?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}¡Pero eso
fue hace la tira!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Como no nos encontrabas a todos,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
nos cansamos de esperar.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Yo ya estaba pensando en ir a casa
a hacerme un bocadillo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Tu joues encore à cache-cache ?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
Mais ça fait une éternité que la
partie est finie !
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}On a attendu et attendu, mais tu
n'es pas {{TAG:000E:0006:0800760065006E0075000A00760065006E0075006500}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Avec les autres,{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}} on a cru que tu
avais arrêté de jouer, {{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}alors je suis
allé goûter.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Stai giocando ancora a nascondino?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}
Guarda che abbiamo smesso
di giocare almeno un secolo fa!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Sei stat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} troppo lent{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
A un certo punto stavo pensando
di andare a casa a farmi un panino!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Verstecken?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Aber das war doch
schon vor Eeewigkeiten!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Wir haben uns beim Warten die
Beine in den Bauch gestanden!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Und das ohne Proviant!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Saklambaç mı?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}O çok eskidendi!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
Biz{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} sonsuza kadar saklandık ama sen
bizi bulmaya hiç gelmedin!
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}O kadar bekledik ki sonunda saklanmayı
bırakıp atıştırmalık bir şeyler almamız gerekti.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Hide-and-seek?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I totally forgot we
were playing that.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}You didn't find
everyone,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} so eventually we gave up.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿El escondite?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ya ni me acordaba
de que estuvimos jugando.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Como
no te vi buscar en serio,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} lo dejé.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Ah ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'avais totalement oublié qu'on
jouait à cache-cache.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Mais ça fait
un moment que j'ai arrêté.
J'ai attendu, attendu et encore
attendu que tu trouves tout le
monde,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et j'ai fini par abandonner.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Verstecken?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wann haben wir das
denn gespielt?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ach jaaa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Aber das
ist doch schon total lang her!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Du hast nicht alle gefunden, und
dann hatte irgendwann keiner
mehr Lust weiterzuspielen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Saklambaç mı?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Onu oynadığımızı tamamen
unutmuştum.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:001B:}}Herkesi bulamadın,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} biz de
sonunda pes ettik.

EN:
We quit that game of hide-and-seek
a while ago!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}You didn't come
looking, so we figured you'd bailed.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}What if someone fell asleep while
they were hiding?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} They might end
up hiding all night long!
ES:
Ah, ¿pero seguíamos jugando
al escondite?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Pues yo no te vi
muy por la labor, la verdad!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}De hecho me quedé dormido
esperando a ver si te lo tomabas
en serio,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡y casi pillo un catarro!
FR:
Ben ! Ça fait longtemps qu'on a
arrêté de jouer à cache-cache,
non ?
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}T'arrivais pas à trouver tout le
monde, alors au bout d'un moment,
on a décidé d'en rester là !
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}On s'est même demandé si t'avais
pas abandonné, c'est dire !
IT:
È un pezzo che abbiamo smesso
di giocare a nascondino!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0006:}}Cosa
avremmo dovuto fare?!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ti sei praticamente ritirat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
senza avvertire!
DE:
Verstecken ist doch längst vorbei!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Wir haben ewig gewartet, aber du
hast trotzdem nicht alle gefunden.
{{TAG:0003:000C:}}Tja, und dann haben alle Hunger
bekommen und sind weggegangen.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}I know it's only a game,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but you
shouldn't just quit halfway through!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Sé que solo es un juego,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡pero
tampoco es cuestión de dejarlo
y largarte sin avisar!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}So che è solo un gioco,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ma
non puoi mica piantarmi lì
sul più bello!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Sadece oyun olduğunu biliyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ama
yarısında öylece bırakılmaz ki!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Disappearing like that{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} really wasn't
cool, you know.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Desaparecer así por las buenas{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
es un detalle muy feo, ¿eh?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ça se fait pas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ça,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} de laisser
tomber les copains en pleine partie.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Svignarsela così{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} è stato
davvero un colpo basso!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Ich finde es echt doof, dass du
einfach abgehauen bist!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Öyle ortadan kaybolman{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} hiç hoş değildi,
biliyor musun.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Essaie de me trouver plus vite la
prochaine fois, OK,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bir dahaki sefere bizi daha çabuk bul,
tamam mı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
